brief_before.title: Northstar Workshop — Brief
brief_before.text:
Northstar Workshop
Date: October 20
Time: 2–5 pm
Venue: Level 3 Seminar Room, Northstar Building — confirmed
Purpose
A half-day working session with the Northstar Collective to agree the
next quarter's priorities and leave with a single written plan.
Running order
1. Where we are — 30 min
1. What is in the way — 45 min
1. Break — 15 min
1. What we will do about it — 60 min
1. Who owns what, and by when — 30 min
Attendees
Priya Raman (Northstar Collective), the facilitation team, and up to
twelve participants from the client side.
Materials
Printed worksheets, two flip charts, markers. The room has a projector;
bring an HDMI adapter.

Venue: Level 3 Seminar Room, Northstar Building

priorities. Your team's view matters to the outcome, so please come
ready to talk about what is actually getting in the way.
Please arrive ten minutes early. Tea and coffee are provided.
Reply to this invitation to confirm your place.

Hi Priya,

One dependency to confirm: the room booking we have on file is for October 20 (Level 3 Seminar Room, Northstar Building). Could you please confirm whether the venue has been rebooked for October 27, 2–5 pm, or share the new room details/confirmation reference so we can mark it as confirmed?

rulings.text: Edits are correctly targeted and verified, and mailbox dependency work is recorded with evidence. However, several findings overstate what their excerpts support and are mislabeled as direct facts. In finding fd_000001, the claim includes “2–5 pm” as part of the latest client instruction, which the cited instruction does not state. Findings fd_000002 and fd_000003 also contain inference but are labeled direct facts. Relabel or revise these findings (and add missing excerpts where needed); after that, this can be accepted.

The findings now separate direct facts from assessments; earlier mislabelled findings are rejected. All acceptance criteria are met with edit verifications and receipts aligned. The latest client instruction is evidenced and correctly applied via targeted edits with unrelated text and styles preserved. The mailbox dependency sweep records queries, matched messages, and lists the unresolved venue rebooking dependency; materials were amended accordingly. Costs were within budget.
